messages:
anjali: Heads-up — after the exports map change in 0.4.3 a couple of onboarding sample apps fail on edge runtimes (Cloudflare/Vercel). getting `The requested module does not provide an export 'default'` in worker logs. :grimacing:
chris: ugh. repro steps? which sample?
anjali: sample app `quickstart-node` when built with esbuild -> bundle used on Vercel Edge. import looks like `import Redwood from 'redwood-sdk'` and runtime complains.
kevin: I tried locally with `wrangler dev` and saw same. stack: `TypeError: The requested module does not provide an export named 'default'` coming from the generated bundle.
maria: could be conditional exports pointing at only `./dist/index.mjs` now, so CJS/interop gets weird in bundlers — or bundlers rewrite imports for edge and lose `__esModule` flags.
anjali: here's the exports block that shipped:```json
"exports": {
  ".": { "import": "./dist/index.mjs", "types": "./dist/index.d.ts" }
}```
anjali: you can see there's no `require` entry. that was deliberate for smaller mjs diff, but it breaks downstream bundlers that expect both paths.
chris: that explains it. But we're also seeing auth retries misbehave in edge builds — requests sent twice sometimes when using the SDK from an edge function. anyone else?
kevin: yes. I traced it to the fetch wrapper: edge bundlers rewrite global `fetch` and our retry shim wraps it differently in ESM output vs CJS. in the worker build we end up with two retry layers sometimes.
maria: so two issues from the same change: export map causing import interop errors, and ESM-only build changing bundler transforms that cause retry wrapper duplication. :disappointed:
pkg-bot: New release published: redwood-sdk@0.4.4 (patch) — includes a temporary exports fallback for require users.
anjali: thanks. is 0.4.4 the fix we should recommend?
pkg-bot: 0.4.4 adds `require` target and a small compatibility shim. see release notes: github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-js/releases/tag/v0.4.4
chris: quick workaround for affected apps: pin to `0.4.2` or upgrade to `0.4.4` — also add this to docs: note for edge runtimes use `import { createClient } from 'redwood-sdk/dist/edge'` if you need a trimmed runtime until we stabilize.
kevin: I pushed a tiny patch that guards double-wrapping of fetch: `if (globalThis.__redwood_fetch_wrapped) return fetch; globalThis.__redwood_fetch_wrapped = true;` — PR: github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-js/pull/789
maria: can we also add a CI job that bundles the samples with esbuild/rollup targeting `browser`/`edge` so we catch regressions? we keep missing these because unit tests run in node.
chris: +1. a minimal smoke test that runs quickstart app build + a headless bundle sanity check would catch missing `require` keys and duplicate globals.
anjali: action items: 1) doc note and onboarding blurb to pin or upgrade (I'll draft) 2) merge the fetch guard PR (kevin) 3) add an esbuild bundle smoke job to devex CI (maria) 4) follow-up to canonicalize exports map with both `import` and `require` + types (engineering).
maria: assign to eng-team? tagging @chris for exports map follow-up and @kevin for retry guard.
chris: I'll open a follow-up PR to make the exports map explicit and add tests. will include a `./dist/edge/index.mjs` path for edge-optimized entry as well.
kevin: merging fetch guard PR now. will cut 0.4.5 if we need more patches.
anjali: I'll update the onboarding quickstart README with recommended pinned versions and a short note on edge bundlers and typings.
deploy-bot: Deploy queued: docs/update-quickstart (jenkins job #421)
anjali: thanks all — can we add a short blurb in the release notes about the typing path? a few users reported TS server not resolving types because `types` was only under `.` import entry.
maria: yes add `types` at the top-level and under both import/require. I'll include that in the exports PR.
chris: long-term: add a matrix to release checklist: [node CJS, node ESM, vite, esbuild, cloudflare, vercel]. we can't expect to catch every bundler quirk but that would reduce breaks. :thumbsup:
anjali: OK closing this thread once docs PR is up. thanks for quick triage. :tada:
